2608.10360.title: MazzikaAI: A knowledge-based performance-to-prompt compiler for real-time Arabic maqam accompaniment with a streaming text-to-music model
2608.10360.paper_summary: Arabic maqam music microtonal, modal, and built on ornamented call and response is among the traditions most underserved by generative music models, whose training frameworks remain predominantly Western and equaltempered. Real time accompaniment sharpens this gap: an AI partner must listen, adapt dynamically, and respect idiomatic microtonal structures. Streaming text to music models provide strong generative capabilities but lack precise control interfaces. We present MazzikaAI, a knowledge based system that uses natural language as the actuator of a realtime control loop. By compiling live MIDI, gesture, and inferred harmony into continuously updated text prompts, MazzikaAI steers an unmodified streaming generator, Google Lyria RealTime, without requiring model finetuning. The system embeds expert knowledge of six core maqamat, characteristic ornaments, and ensemble dynamics, maintaining realtime responsiveness with subsecond keytoaudibleupdate latency. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that dynamic prompt compilation reliably grounds generation in microtonal scales, significantly increasing offgrid quartertone content over baseline generation. Beyond its core implementation, MazzikaAI illustrates how deterministic knowledgebased rules can effectively bridge expert, nonWestern musical traditions and unfinetuned foundation models. This architecture establishes a scalable paradigm for realtime humanAI cocreation, offering a generalizable blueprint for interactive accompaniment, adaptive music education, and culturally inclusive generative audio across diverse global idioms.
2608.10360.paper_summary_zh: 阿拉伯音階音樂是微音階的、模態的，並且基於裝飾性的呼叫與回應，這些傳統在生成音樂模型中最被忽視，這些模型的訓練框架仍然主要是西方的和等溫的。實時伴奏加劇了這一差距：一個AI夥伴必須聆聽、動態適應並尊重習慣性的微音階結構。將文本流式傳輸到音樂模型提供強大的生成能力，但缺乏精確的控制介面。我們提出了MazzikaAI，一個基於知識的系統，使用自然語言作為實時控制迴路的驅動器。通過將現場MIDI、手勢和推斷的和聲編譯成不斷更新的文本提示，MazzikaAI引導未經修改的流式生成器Google Lyria RealTime，而無需模型微調。該系統嵌入了六個核心音階、特徵裝飾和合奏動態的專家知識，保持實時響應，具有亞秒的鍵到可聽更新延遲。實證評估表明，動態提示編譯可靠地將生成基於微音階，顯著增加了基線生成的離網四分之一音內容。超越其核心實現，MazzikaAI展示了如何有效地橋接專家和非西方音樂傳統與未經微調的基礎模型的確定性基於知識的規則。這一架構建立了一個可擴展的實時人類AI共同創作範式，為互動伴奏、自適應音樂教育和跨多元全球方言的文化包容性生成音頻提供了一個可普遍應用的藍圖。
